Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Barfoot
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 01/24/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 93 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Home Medical Equipment until October 1, 2026 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
